descriptionHtml:
Dominate modern games and demanding creative workloads with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX10! Driven by a powerful 14th Gen Intel Core i7-14700HX processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB graphics, and a vibrant 100% sRGB 144Hz display, this laptop delivers exceptional speed, fidelity, and reliability.
